card.name: Digits inside phone numbers
card.fires_on: Digits and hyphens within the last block of a phone number, usually in event or contact listings after phrases like 'for more info' or 'call'.

modes.label: Hyphen before last digits
modes.description: The hyphen that separates the final digit group of an international phone number.

modes.label: Digits in last group
modes.description: A single digit inside the final four-digit group of a US-style phone number.

card.plain: It fires on the digits of a phone number, mostly the last few, in event and contact listings.
